'''Korek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Around [[3640 BBY]] he was with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Solrak]] on [[Voss]], where Korek sent Solrak to bring back artifacts from the [[Nightmare Lands]]. The corruption of the place, however, was too strong and Solrak asked an Imperial to retrieve the artifacts for him instead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Korek appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Covetous" on Voss.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
